periods.time: Night before the Seven Stars opening ceremony

name.en: Ouma Attempts to Force Ikki's Withdrawal

periods.summary: Ouma confronts Ikki, orders him to withdraw from Seven Stars, and attacks when Ikki refuses. The fight reveals that Ikki's body freezes at decisive moments after his duel with Edelweiss, and Moroboshi saves Ikki from Ouma's Kusanagi.
periods.cause: Ouma believes Ikki's low-rank methods are trickery that misled Stella and hindered her growth after losing to Ouma.
periods.process: Ouma attacks with vacuum blades, close-range sword blows, the oxygen-removing Muukuu Barrier and Kusanagi. Ikki uses Ittou Shura but suddenly freezes during decisive approaches. Moroboshi arrives with Ikki's student handbook, uses Tiger Bite to destroy Kusanagi and the wind barrier, and confronts Ouma.
periods.outcome: Ouma withdraws, predicting Ikki will lose to Moroboshi. Ikki spends the night unable to identify the cause of his paralysis and enters the tournament with a hidden fear.
periods.significance: Creates the central tactical/psychological problem of Ikki's first-round match and demonstrates Tiger Bite against Ouma's magic.
